title: Documentation Mission
definition: The purpose or goal of the documentation system, which is to preserve wisdom, enable excellence, and ensure continuity.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Documentation has three main jobs: to help people remember important information, to help people do their best work, and to make sure everyone is on the same page, no matter what happens.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The documentation mission includes preserving institutional knowledge, enabling users and developers to excel, and ensuring that system understanding is maintained across time and team changes.
difficulty_levels.expert: The documentation mission reflects the integration of the ancient Hieros principle of sacred knowledge architecture with modern documentation practices. It highlights the need for documentation to not only serve a technical function but also to embody a philosophical commitment to preserving and sharing knowledge.

extra_fields.insight: The documentation mission emphasizes the importance of documentation as a means of preserving wisdom, enabling excellence, and ensuring continuity in the face of change.
